newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST-Mexico 29-day Cetes seen at 21.04 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Mexico 29-day Cetes seen at 21.04 pct.

text.p: Interest rates on Mexico's bellwether 29-day Cetes, or T-bills, are seen falling 66 basis points to 21.04 percent, and rates are also seen falling at longer terms, according to a Reuter survey of nine Cetes dealers.
Following is a table comparing last week's primary rates versus expectations for this week's auction and the expected change in basis points.
TERM LAST WEEK THIS WEEK'S SURVEY CHANGE
The results will be released by Banco de Mexico at 1830 (0030 GMT).
The auction is being held one day earlier than normal to take into account the Easter holiday.
